Section 14. Indemnification. The Service Provider agrees to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its affiliates, directors, officers, and employees from and against any third-party claims arising out of any gross negligence or willful misconduct of Service Provider.

Paragraph 6. Defense and Indemnity. Vendor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Licensee from all liabilities, judgments, and legal costs arising from Vendor's material breach of confidentiality obligations.
Paragraph 10. Damages Limitation. Under no circumstances shall either party be liable for punitive or consequential damages. Vendor's total liability shall be capped at three times (3x) the annual subscription fee.
